title: Humanitarian access improves
assumption: Assumption, not prediction: access expands enough for more regular aid movement and service restoration.
risks: Bottlenecks shift from access to distribution equity.
Unmet needs may become more visible.
responsibleActions: Prioritize accountable WASH, health, and nutrition channels.

title: Access remains restricted
assumption: Assumption, not prediction: access remains limited and intermittent.
risks: Food, health, WASH, and protection risks compound.
Disease and malnutrition monitoring gaps widen.
responsibleActions: Advocate for humanitarian access and civilian protection.
Avoid tactical details or unsupported routing.

title: Regional escalation increases pressure
assumption: Assumption, not prediction: regional escalation diverts attention, logistics, and diplomacy.
risks: Funding and supply chains become more stressed.
responsibleActions: Support multi-sector organizations with accountability evidence.
Build civic learning spaces that reduce dehumanization.

title: Reconstruction and education recovery begin
assumption: Assumption, not prediction: conditions allow early reconstruction, school recovery, and service rehabilitation.
risks: Recovery may be inequitable or politically contested.
Youth agency may be symbolic rather than real.
responsibleActions: Invest in teachers, psychosocial care, WASH, and public health systems.
Route youth programs through safeguarding protocols.
